§6Bedrock Ore Processing§f

§aMulti-stage processing for infinite resources  -  centrifuge, wash, roast, repeat!§f

Bedrock ore processing has several stages, each adding byproducts and boosting yields. All ore types share the same chain, so one setup handles everything.

§6The Chain§f:
§b1. Slopping§f: Processor splits raw ore into categories.
§b2. Centrifuging§f: First pass creates second-stage ore.
§b3. Washing§f (Ore Acidizer)  -  the key step:
§b•§f §bWater§f before centrifuging doubles all products. Free and huge.
§b•§f Sulfuric Acid adds tier 1 byproducts.
§b•§f Solvent adds tier 2 byproducts.
§b•§f High-Performance Solvent adds all three tiers.
§b•§f Liquid Hydrogen boosts primary yield.
§b•§f Chlorine Gas boosts secondary yield.
§b4. Roasting§f (Combination/Pyrolysis Oven) gives Vitriol as a free bonus.

§6Stages§f: Raw to Centrifuged to Cleaned to Separated to Purified or Nitrated to Nitrocrystalline to Deep Cleaned or Seared.

§cWARNING:§f Never skip the water wash. It doubles everything for zero cost!
